summary: User inquires why the Java SDK doesn't use the Rust Core SDK like TypeScript, Python, .NET, and Ruby do, and asks about technical limitations or considerations for building a Java SDK on top of Rust Core.
userImpact: Users seeking to understand SDK architecture decisions and evaluate whether building a Java SDK on Rust Core is feasible for their needs.
rootCause: Java's poor native compilation and shared library distribution story, combined with Java SDK existing as a pure implementation before Rust Core was available.
resolutionDetails: Issue closed as not an issue. The Java SDK remains pure because it predates Rust Core and Java has poor native library support. Go faces the same constraints.
keyQuote: Java has a bad native compilation and shared library distribution story
